Mei O'Brien
mei.obrien@example.com | Raleigh, NC
SUMMARY
Results-driven backend engineer with 15 years of experience building backend systems on TypeScript,
AWS, Distributed systems.
EXPERIENCE
Principal Backend Engineer - Timberline Software (2022-2026)
- Designed a Python-backed data layer that cut p99 query latency by 53%.
- Designed internal Node.js standards used by 18+ downstream services.
- Built and maintained REST APIs in Node.js serving 393K requests/day.
Staff Backend Engineer - Redbank Platform (2018-2022)
- Owned the Kafka event pipeline processing 31M events/day.
- Introduced Terraform-managed infrastructure, cutting provisioning time by 82%.
Senior Backend Engineer - Harborlight Analytics (2011-2018)
- Applied distributed-systems patterns to scale the platform to 113K concurrent users.
- Led migration of core services at Harborlight Analytics onto Java, improving uptime during peak load.
EDUCATION
Ph.D. Software Engineering, Drexel University, 2011
B.S. Software Engineering, Purdue University, 2005
SKILLS
- TypeScript
- AWS
- Distributed systems
- Kubernetes
- REST API design
- Terraform
- Java
- PostgreSQL
- Python
- Node.js
- System design
- GraphQL
